rules.coverage_text: Rental units covered by the San Francisco Rent Ordinance, including some units exempt from rent increase limits.

key_values.name: just_cause_reasons
key_values.text: The 17 just cause reasons for eviction under Ordinance Section 37.9(a)

rules.penalty: Landlord may be subject to substantial civil and/or criminal liability for unlawful eviction.
rules.quote: In order to evict a tenant from a rental unit covered by the Rent Ordinance, a landlord must have a "just cause" reason that is the dominant motive for pursuing the eviction.
rules.requirement: A landlord must have one of the enumerated just cause reasons as the dominant motive to evict a tenant from a covered unit. Expiration of a rental agreement or change in ownership is not just cause.
rules.title: Just cause required for eviction
